items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.lead_paragraph: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.lead_paragraph: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.lead_paragraph: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.lead_paragraph: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.lead_paragraph: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

items.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

items.title: See PR scans in action
items.lead_paragraph: Watch a walkthrough of PR scans and see how the presenter reviews scan results in a pull request workflow.

items.title: Get started with Daybreak Blue
items.lead_paragraph: Watch a walkthrough of onboarding to Daybreak Blue, with a closer look at the setup experience and how to get started.

items.title: Explore the Codex Security Plugin
items.lead_paragraph: Watch a demo of the Codex Security Plugin and see the workflow in action, from getting started to reviewing the results shown in the recording.

items.title: Deploying Daybreak Red
items.lead_paragraph: Explore a reference architecture for supervised security investigations with Daybreak Red, including safety controls, setup, and monitoring.

items.title: The Silent Consensus
items.lead_paragraph: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

items.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

items.title: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
items.lead_paragraph: Sumitomo Life uses ChatGPT Enterprise to research insurers, prepare proposals, and draft code for investment analysis. Early use by executives helped drive adoption.

items.title: Inside the Codex sandbox
items.lead_paragraph: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

items.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

items.title: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro journalism to ChatGPT
items.lead_paragraph: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro’s journalism to ChatGPT through summaries and excerpts, with links to original stories.

items.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.lead_paragraph: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
items.lead_paragraph: Explore the new Sales plugin and 30+ new and expanded partner plugins in ChatGPT to research prospects, prepare pitches, update your CRM, and move deals forward.

items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.lead_paragraph: Using agent teams and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.
